human_judge_agreement.note: Strong rank agreement (rho=0.70) on a small sample. LLM judge is slightly conservative (consistently scores 0.2-0.4 below human on tone and actionability). p-value not significant at n=5; a 20+ sample would confirm. Harness ready to re-run at scale.
